About Us

37 years of Expertise. A Smarter Future Powered by AI.

Established in 1989, Harmony Lighting is a global lighting solutions and supply chain management company, combining decades of industry expertise with advanced technology to deliver comprehensive lighting solutions for international businesses.

With offices in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Guzhen, we provide integrated services across product sourcing, design and development, engineering, manufacturing coordination, quality management, and global logistics.

Our strength comes from an experienced team with an average tenure of over 12 years and a trusted network of more than 500 audited factories. We have built long-standing partnerships with international clients, supporting their growth through consistent quality, reliability, and execution.

Where Experience Meets Innovation

Building on our industry expertise, we developed LightingAI, our proprietary AI-powered platform that transforms how businesses discover products, evaluate manufacturers, and manage their supply chains.

From intelligent product matching and factory ratings to order tracking, quality reporting, price benchmarking, and market insights, LightingAI brings greater efficiency, transparency, and control to every stage of the process.

Harmony Lighting — Combining 37 years of industry expertise with intelligent technology to shape the future of lighting.
